scope: Simple pair bench inside the full game with a loaded save (original with the function hook off vs candidate with the hook on), 26880 isolated CPU pairs for 54 functions of CPathFind, ALL pairs equal, pair counts equal to the bank table, passed=true globally, natural "complete" event with state_restored, saves unchanged, configs restored. Traced doubles get NO credit. Only the own part of each function is validated. Source tested == current working tree at registration (class sources match the probe build manifest). Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation. Padding and uninitialised bytes masked. Limits are declared per function in the function-specific scope and in the bank README.
